relations.subject: O-PF-01
relations.constraint: feed 字段映射须能回溯事实表版本；渠道适配差异显式标注

relations.subject: O-PF-01
relations.constraint: 一个 feed 可含多商品；跨源映射未验证标 unmapped

relations.subject: O-PF-02
relations.constraint: 实验对象是页面呈现；结论须有对照与窗口

relations.subject: O-PF-03
relations.constraint: Shopify Markets 与业务市场一一对应；配置版本化

relations.subject: O-PF-04
relations.constraint: 审核发生在发货前；拦截/放行是高风险动作（权限 v0.1 B 层）

relations.subject: O-PF-05
relations.constraint: A+/Store 挂商品；备案材料挂品牌范围

relations.subject: O-PF-06
relations.constraint: FBA 记录按商品×市场粒度

relations.subject: O-PF-06
relations.constraint: 仅 Amazon 渠道账号；币种随市场

relations.subject: O-PF-07
relations.constraint: 达人带货按商品归因；类目匹配是建联前提

relations.subject: O-PF-08
relations.constraint: 寄样是实物+对外承诺动作，须客户确认（权限 v0.1）

relations.subject: O-PF-09
relations.constraint: 场次可带多商品；场次 GMV 按商品拆分

relations.subject: O-PF-09
relations.constraint: 仅 TikTok Shop 渠道账号

relations.subject: O-PF-10
relations.constraint: 周期快照；阈值与申诉规则平台版本化

relations.subject: O-PF-11
relations.constraint: GMV Max/平台活动均绑定账号；预算变更须客户确认

relations.subject: O-PF-12
relations.constraint: 开店/建站项目交付物；经 SubScenario（O-OPS-05）归属

relations.subject: O-PF-13
relations.constraint: 每场次一份策划包；复盘结论回写场次指标

relations.subject: O-PF-14
relations.constraint: 应诉材料一包一案；提交动作客户执行

relations.subject: O-PF-07
relations.constraint: 达人带货效果与投放记录交叉归因（周报 T-PF-16）
